itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter2_verse5.title: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 2 Verse 5
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter2_verse5.introduction: This verse belongs to Chapter 2 of the Bhagavad Gita.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter2_verse5.scripture_text: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 2, Verse 5 teaches disciplined action, inner clarity, and devotion to the Divine as a path to liberation.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter2_verse5.philosophical_explanation: This verse contributes to Krishna's teaching on dharma, yoga, and liberation.
